text:
incident-bot: ALERT -> api-gateway: high 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate (eu region). Trigger: 5xx_rate > 1% for 3m. Link: <http://alerts/internal/1760007890>

pagerduty-bot: Paging rotation: @maria (oncall)

maria (oncall): Ack. Investigating. Any customer reports yet?

jordan (support): Got two tickets about timeouts to /v1/generate from EU customers, started ~10:13Z. They report 502/504.

maria (oncall): Confirmed spike in gateway 502/504. Triage plan: 1) check recent deploys 2) check upstream providers and latency 3) scale gateway and reduce retries.

sunil (platform): No infra deploys in the last hour. Gateway pool CPU ~85%. Upstream model-host-x shows p99 latency jumps and connection timeouts.

hana (sre): Hypothesis: upstream model hosts are timing out -> gateway returns 502/504. Recommend immediate mitigations: disable aggressive retries, scale gateway, and enable short circuit for failing upstreams.

maria (oncall): Immediate actions (live):
- sunil: reduce per-request retries from 3 -> 1 on gateway and roll canary
- sunil: scale gateway pool +2 replicas now
- hana: enable fallback to cache for embedding endpoints where available
- jordan: draft customer status blurb if impact persists

sunil (platform): Scaling started, 2 replicas requested. Pushed retry flag to canary (staging pass). Rolling to prod. Logs show retry_attempts now 1 -> 0 for failed hosts.

incident-bot: Runbook step triggered: "check-upstream-latency". See: <http://runbooks/internal/check-upstream-latency>

maria (oncall): Monitoring: error rate dropped from 4.2% -> 1.3% over 8m after scaling + retry change. Still above current paging threshold of 1.0%.

hana (sre): We should tune the 5xx alert to reduce alert storms for transient upstream blips. Current alert: "api_gateway_5xx_rate > 1% for 3m". Proposal: primary (notice) -> >1.5% for 5m (no page), critical (page) -> >2.5% for 3m. Also correlate with upstream_degraded flag to suppress noisy pages.

maria (oncall): +1 to suppressing pages when upstream_degraded==true. We saw noisy pages when provider briefly degraded last month.

sunil (platform): Draft PromQL for primary notice alert (5m window):
```
(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-gateway",status=~"5.."}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-gateway"}[5m]))) * 100 > 1.5
```
And critical paging rule (3m):
```
(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-gateway",status=~"5.."}[3m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-gateway"}[3m]))) * 100 > 2.5
```

hana (sre): Also add an alert suppression condition: do not page if (upstream_provider_degraded == 1) for the same timeframe. We'll correlate via label on the provider metrics.

jordan (support): For customers: recommend status note: "We are seeing elevated timeouts for generation endpoints; engineers are mitigating. Some requests may fail. ETA: 15-30m." Keep it concise.

maria (oncall): If errors stay >1.5% for 10m we'll post to status.redwood.com. Follow-ups:
- PR to alerting repo to change thresholds + suppress rule (owner: hana)
- Dashboard panel for upstream timeout/latency and frontend 5xx (owner: sunil)
- Runbook update to add upstream check & reroute steps (owner: hana)
- Evaluate cache TTLs for possible broader fallback (owner: jordan/hana)

hana (sre): Creating PR now with tests that ensure pages are suppressed when upstream_degraded==1. Will add changelog entry.

sunil (platform): I'll add a Grafana panel for upstream p50/p95/p99 latency and a heatmap for timeout counts. Will change the grafana alert to only forward to PagerDuty for the critical rule.

maria (oncall): Summary: Incident classified as "Partial customer impact - transient upstream timeouts". Mitigated by scaling gateway and reducing retries. Immediate customer impact decreased.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED -> api-gateway 5xx rate stable under 1% for 20m. Auto-close at 1760007955.

maria (oncall): Thanks all. Postmortem owners: hana (cause & alerting), sunil (dashboards & platform), jordan (customer comms). We'll do a 30m post-incident sync tomorrow 10:00 to review follow-ups. :thumbsup:
